Beam's Windsor body wind-tunnel example ships geometry from WindsorML.

File: src/simulation/assets/windsor_1.stl.gz, bundled as a build asset. It is
run_1/windsor_1.stl from https://huggingface.co/datasets/neashton/windsorml,
compressed with gzip and otherwise unmodified.

WindsorML: High-Fidelity Computational Fluid Dynamics Dataset For Automotive
Aerodynamics. Neil Ashton, Jordan B. Angel, Aditya S. Ghate, Gaetan K. W. Kenway,
Man Long Wong, Cetin Kiris, Astrid Walle, Danielle C. Maddix and Gary Page, 2024.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.19320

Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

Beam compares its result with the dataset's drag coefficient for this run,
Cd 0.3225 on a reference area of 0.112 m² (run_1/force_mom_1.csv).
